It is FRIENDLY to single-name mean reversion on the receiving side of the rotation, which is the read that supported today's MDLZ equity entry.
regime.honest_limit: Measured 5-7 minutes into the session. A rotation visible at 13:35Z can be fully reversed by 15:00Z; this label is a starting frame, not a forecast.
